# Review Rubric

Load this reference when reviewing current or updated efficiency work.

Use this rubric:

- `Scope discipline`: only relevant GitHub Actions guidance was loaded
- `Safety`: required validation coverage, including nUIget's mandatory suites, was preserved
- `Token efficiency`: the skill or report stayed focused on the active task
- `Measurement quality`: expected and measured gains were clearly separated
- `Authorization`: no test pushes, commits, or branch mutations occurred without explicit
  authorization

If one rubric dimension is weak, call it out explicitly instead of averaging it away.
